purpose: Exact webpage rendering specs for watch-face circular gauges. Agents should use these specs to generate HTML/CSS/SVG instead of inferring visuals from screenshots.

requirements: Render rings and measured dots in SVG for precise geometry.
Render text either as absolutely positioned HTML or SVG text using the provided typography tokens.
Use vector-effect='non-scaling-stroke' only if the SVG viewBox is scaled by CSS; otherwise render at the exact size token.
Do not rasterize the Figma component for final webpage UI.
Do not stretch circular gauges outside their fixed size token.

arcMath.pointOnCircle: angleRadians = degToRad(angleDegrees); x = centerX + radius * cos(angleRadians); y = centerY + radius * sin(angleRadians)
arcMath.invalidRangeFallback: If max equals min, set normalized to 0.5 and do not imply precision.

colorPolicy.rule: Circular widget colors are resolved by watch-face-generation-rules.md before rendering. Components consume widget_accent_color or the component-specific two-color open gauge rule; they do not invent independent colors.

rules: Apply widget_accent_color to the text, icon, number, and value arc.
The base ring always uses fixedDefaults.trackGray.
Do not use gradients in close_gauge.
The open ring, measure, text, number, and icon use widget_accent_color.
The open ring uses start_color to end_color as a gradient.
For open_gauge.text and open_gauge.icon, the measure, text, number, and icon use the interpolated color between start_color and end_color based on normalized measure position.
For open_gauge.range, the low number uses start_color and the high number uses end_color.

For open_gauge.offset, assign the two colors as set and offset colors. Set text and measure use set_color; offset text and measure use offset_color. The value arc uses the gradient from set_color to offset_color.

sharedTypography.fontFamily: SF Compact, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

semanticComponentSpec.description: Closed circular gauge for a single one-direction metric with an optional center icon or one centered value.

data.label: optional footnote for property=text; if rendered, use the fixed footnote text box width for the selected size token
data.soloContentTypeRule: if this close_gauge is the only widget for its content type, use property=icon instead of property=text

footnoteTextRules.clipping: Close gauge footnote text must fit its fixed box without clipping; use a shorter unit label or omit the footnote when it does not fit.

centerValueTextRules.clipping: Close gauge center value must fit its fixed value box without clipping; use shorter display text if needed.

preferredWebImplementation.container: position: relative; width: diameter; height: diameter;
preferredWebImplementation.svg: absolute inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible;
preferredWebImplementation.ring: Use SVG path arcs with stroke-width from the size token and stroke-linecap='round'.
preferredWebImplementation.text: Absolutely position text boxes using the box values, center-align, and use sharedTypography.

semanticComponentSpec.description: Open arc gauge for a metric with optional icon, text, range labels, or offset/reference comparison.

data.value: required for text, icon, range, and offset
data.label: required for property=text; this is the visible bottom text and must fit the selected size token
data.icon: required for property=icon; render in the bottom icon slot, not in the center
data.min: required for range and offset measured-dot placement
data.max: required for range and offset measured-dot placement
data.measuredValue: optional numeric override for the primary measured dot; defaults to value
data.referenceMeasuredValue: optional numeric value for the second offset dot

bottomTextRules.required: Do not leave open_gauge bottom content empty. Text variant requires label, icon variant requires a bottom icon, range requires lowLabel and highLabel, and offset requires referenceValue.
bottomTextRules.clipping: Bottom text must fit its Figma text box without clipping; use a shorter label or icon variant when needed.

centerValueTextRules.appliesTo: open_gauge text, icon, range, and offset centered value
centerValueTextRules.clipping: Open gauge center value must fit its fixed value box without clipping; use shorter display text if needed.

weatherTemperatureExample.expected: The measured dot sits at the right edge of the gauge ring.

dots.colorSource: color interpolated between start_color and end_color by normalized measured value; widget_accent_color when one-color mode is used

preferredWebImplementation.container: position: relative; width: diameter; height: diameter;
preferredWebImplementation.svg: absolute inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible;
preferredWebImplementation.ring: Use SVG path arcs with stroke-width from the size token and stroke-linecap='round'.
preferredWebImplementation.gradient: Use an SVG linearGradient or conic-gradient-derived stroke approximation. The visual intent is a smooth color transition along the open arc.
preferredWebImplementation.dots: Render each measure dot as an SVG circle whose center is computed from the normalized value and open-arc angle mapping.
preferredWebImplementation.text: Absolutely position text boxes using the box values, center-align current and reference text, and use sharedTypography.

validationRules.rule: For open_gauge range and offset variants, a measured value equal to max must place the measured dot at normalized=1, which maps to the right/lower edge of the open gauge ring.
For open_gauge range and offset variants, a measured value equal to min must place the measured dot at normalized=0, which maps to the left/lower edge of the open gauge ring.
For open_gauge range and offset variants, a measured value halfway between min and max must place the measured dot at normalized=0.5, which maps to the top center of the open gauge ring.
Rulebook-resolved color choices must not change size, stroke width, text position, arc angle, or measured-dot position.
